test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If Rs. 1,000 is divided into three parts in the ratio 2 ∶ 3 ∶ 5, find the value of the smallest part.
solution:
**Given:**

Rs. 1,000 is divided into three parts in the ratio 2 ∶ 3 ∶ 5

**Calculation:**

1st part = 1000 × 2/10

⇒ 200

2nd part = 1000 × 3/10

⇒ 300

3rd part = 1000 × 5/10

⇒ 500

So, smallest part = 200

**∴ The smallest part is Rs. 200.**
